title: MagSafe Monday: The TUCCH Mag Wallet feels like a real wallet, not just a slot to stick cards in - 9to5Mac
summary: My biggest issue when I go back and forth between a MagSafe wallet and a traditional wallet is that a lot of MagSafe wallets are really just card slots. It feels like a traditional wallet with MagSafe vs. a MagSafe wallet.
